New Westminster townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® benchmark for townhomes in New Westminster was $854,200 in September 2026 (-6.8% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
New Westminster townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

73 townhomes sold in New Westminster with a median price of $871,000 (the middle half sold between $775,000 and $1,010,000), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 8% sold above list. They had a median $587 per square foot, a median year built of 2007 and a median strata fee of $496 a month.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: New Westminster's townhome stock clusters in Queensborough, the island neighbourhood on the eastern tip of Lulu Island reached by the Queensborough Bridge, where the Ewen Avenue corridor of strata complexes stands; smaller pockets sit at Victoria Hill, Queen's Park and downtown Royal Avenue.

The City's Official Community Plan (OCP) residential neighbourhoods map names ten neighbourhoods — Queensborough, Connaught Heights, West End, Moody Park, Brow of the Hill, Glenbrooke North, Queen's Park, Massey Victory Heights, McBride Sapperton and Downtown including Quayside.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Ewen Avenue in Queensborough holds the counted run: Portside at 488 Furness Street in Port Royal, Coopers Landing at 935 Ewen Avenue, English Mews at 1111 and 1135 Ewen Avenue, Ewen at 843 Ewen Avenue, Alexander Walk at 1211 Ewen Avenue and Oxford Townhomes at 728 Ewen Avenue.
Salter Street adds two more Queensborough complexes in the index: The Peninsula at 210 Salter Street and Paddler's Landing at 250 Salter Street, with Coracle at 260 Ewen Avenue.

On the mainland, the index counts Clinton Place at 114 Park Row in Queen's Park (strata plan NWS262, 14 units, built 1974), Brickstone Walk II at 838 Royal Avenue downtown, the Victoria Hill townhouses at 245 Francis Way and Jamieson Place at 72 Jamieson Court.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Townhouse form is design-controlled city-wide: Development Permit Area (DPA) 1.3, Townhouses and Rowhouses, in the OCP sets guidelines that shape infill townhouse and rowhouse development, and DPA 1.2 covers ground oriented housing.

New townhouse zoning is being rewritten: the City's Interim Development Review Framework, updated June 22, 2026, states townhouse development is expected to proceed as guided by the new RT-A and RT-B zoning districts.

Queensborough townhouses sit on regulated flood plain land: Flood Plain By-law No. 5095, 1978 sets the habitable floor elevation on a gradient from 4.15 metres at the Queensborough Railway Bridge to 4.4 metres at the Patullo Bridge.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Brickstone Walk at 828 Royal Avenue looks like a townhouse complex but is an apartment-form building in the index, while Brickstone Walk II at 838 Royal Avenue is the counted townhouse strata.
Clinton Place at 114 Park Row dates to 1974 — older than the Queensborough stock by decades — under strata plan NWS262.
English Mews carries two civic addresses, 1111 and 1135 Ewen Avenue, for one complex.
The City held no 2026 property tax sale, stating all delinquent taxes were collected — posted September 24, 2026.
City Hall, where the tax sale would have run, is at 511 Royal Avenue, two blocks from the Brickstone Walk complexes.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Two study areas affect future townhouse supply here: the Interim Development Review Framework names the 22nd Street Station Vision Area and the Lower Twelfth and Sharpe Street Study Area as areas where rezoning or OCP amendment applications are considered premature while City study work continues. Status: framework updated June 22, 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: The provincial home owner grant is claimed from the Province, not the City: the City page states the 2026 threshold is $2,075,000 of assessed value, the basic grant is up to $570 and the additional grant for owners 65 and older is up to $845.

The City's pre-authorized pre-payment plan for property taxes and annual utilities runs ten equal withdrawals from August 1 to May 1, a schedule a townhouse owner can set alongside strata fee payments.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: getting around

items.t: TransLink route 103, Quayside to New Westminster Station, serves the waterfront street grid below the Victoria Hill and Jamieson Court townhouses.
Queensborough townhouses depend on the Queensborough Bridge: it is the island neighbourhood's road link to the mainland city and to Highway 91A at the Stewardson Way interchange.

blocks.text: New Westminster Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with flood geography: the City's flood strategy material states about 460 hectares, roughly 30% of the city, lies within the Fraser River floodplain, and Queensborough is protected by the shared perimeter dyke around Lulu Island while mainland lowlands are not diked.

Check the habitable floor elevation against By-law No. 5095, 1978 on any Queensborough purchase, and ask the strata for flood-related records and insurance terms for the Ewen Avenue or Salter Street complex.
